scope: The 65 unmatched SCORE mentions in project-classification-preview.json before this review. Project membership only; not a published-paper cohort assignment.

file_to_report_component_provenance.method: Matched every permanent record ID and exact report URL to the pinned audit; checked live OSF report-component and parent metadata. One private parent required the SCORE-labelled preregistration in the same component.

limits: Project membership does not prove inclusion in any specific published SCORE paper.

This membership review itself applies no author, citation or identifier correction. Subsequent paper-identifier additions are documented separately in data/corrections/SCORE_PAPER_IDENTIFIERS.md; tracked outputs remain unedited.
OSF contributors and preregistration team names are not substituted for report bylines.
